name: VR.net event-level score regression exploratory pilot
history_interval: [report_time-60s, report_time); strictly prior, no contemporaneous/future features
cleaning: recompute camera speed and scalar-speed acceleration within monotone <=1s intervals and <=10 source-unit displacements; invalidate object speeds at camera coordinate discontinuities; negative/nonfinite motion -> missing; no metric-driven thresholds
preprocessing: fixed log1p of nonnegative feature values; training-fold median imputation then VarianceThreshold(1e-10); Ridge training-fold StandardScaler; no test-game normalization; no IDs/raw timestamps/prior scores/interaction inputs
evaluation: Leave-One-Subject-Out using modern README filename convention
fit_weights: inverse event count per training session, normalized to training mean weight=1
tuning: none; all fixed model/feature variants reported; no select-and-retest claim
label_policy: one real rating event per sample; no carry-forward or future labels; native auto/manual excluded
inference: raw continuous score prediction; no clipping/rebinning; out-of-observed-range outputs counted
limitations: runtime features not certified pure design settings
symmetric-equivalent FOV may differ from asymmetric XR FOV
position units not independently verified as metres
visible renderer entries not total GameObject density
object names are not stable instance IDs
repeated ratings and overlapping histories not independent
LOGO may overlap participants; LOSO may overlap games
no calibration or intervention effectiveness established
protocol_gate: supplementary regression exploration; original classification AUC gate is not evaluated or passed
